policy.provenance: All source contact pages reviewed, then action hypotheses checked with densely sampled source-PTS sequences, before opening this baseline's predictions or tuning production matcher code.
policy.precision: Requires separate visual adjudication of returned pairs. Sparse-reference hit rate is not precision.
policy.weak: Ordinary talking portraits without a distinctive gesture/action/composition are weak, not strong positives and not automatically false positives in head-position mode.
policy.nearDuplicate: Redundancy controls, not strong new parallels; same-shot samples and repeated coverage must be reported separately from unrelated false positives.
policy.holdout: Entire mosh-e02 is reserved for final evaluation, never parameter/feature tuning.
policy.crossSource: Evaluate only in a multi-input run containing both sources; exclude from denominators of single-input runs.
policy.ranges: Seconds on original presentation timeline, narrowed to the verified action rather than whole shots. Both representative frames must fall within the corresponding ranges (swapping A/B permitted); interval overlap alone does not prove a hit.
policy.limitations: Not exhaustive annotation of every possible action; camera-only semantics and object recognition are beyond a pose-only matcher. Character tags describe visible different performers, not inferred identity labels. No production filename/timestamp special cases.
